footer.blurb: Lisan screens children for lisps in Egyptian Arabic and guides daily practice at home, under a speech therapist's supervision.

home.hook: Does your child say “thamaka” instead of “samaka”?
home.title: Help your child say S right
home.subtitle: A playful AI speech coach that listens, finds the tricky sounds and turns practice into a 10-minute daily adventure.
home.problemTitle: Lisps are common and very treatable — but practice is hard to sustain.

access.title: Few therapists
access.body: Speech therapists are concentrated in big cities; sessions are costly and weekly at best.

practice.title: The practice gap
practice.body: Progress comes from daily repetition at home, but parents can't tell if the sound was right.

late.title: Noticed late
late.body: Many lisps are dismissed as “cute” and become harder to correct with time.

arabic.title: Arabic is missing
arabic.body: Most speech apps are English-only. Egyptian س ز ش ص are barely covered.

check.title: Check
check.body: Your child names ~30 pictures in a short game. Lisan listens to every target sound.

plan.title: Plan
plan.body: You get a clear result and a step-by-step plan your therapist can review and approve.

practice.title: Practice
practice.body: 10 minutes a day with a friendly guide, instant feedback and rewards.

how.title: From one spoken word to the right next exercise.
how.intro: Because the app always shows a known word, Lisan doesn't need general speech recognition — it only checks whether one expected sound was said correctly. That makes it accurate and explainable.

screening.title: 1 · The screening game
screening.body: A picture appears, the guide asks “What is this?”, and your child says the word. About 30 pictures cover س and ز at the start, middle and end of words. No right or wrong is shown — just stars for trying.

ai.title: 2 · The AI analysis
ai.body: Each recording goes through a short pipeline. When the model isn't sure, it asks the child to say it again instead of guessing.

align.title: Align
align.body: Find exactly where the س is in the word.

classify.title: Classify
classify.body: Correct, interdental, dentalized, lateral or palatal — with confidence.

dsp.title: Explain
dsp.body: Signal features: a clear س has most energy at 4–8 kHz.

score.title: Score
score.body: Accuracy per sound and position → severity.

plan.title: 3 · The plan
plan.body: Results become a plan on the therapy ladder. Severity sets the pace, and the lisp type picks the warm-ups.

bands.typical: 85% and above — short check-in plan, 2–3 weeks
bands.severe: Below 50% — full plan + in-person therapist visit

practice.title: 4 · Daily practice
practice.body: Each day unlocks a short quest: a mouth warm-up, sound practice, a word game, a story or song. A correct sound fills the meter and the guide celebrates; a miss gets a gentle “Let's try with teeth closed” and a model sound.

faq.a: No. Lisan is screening and guided practice. Every report says to confirm with a speech therapist.

faq.q: How long does it take each day?
faq.a: Sessions are 5–10 minutes. Short and daily works better than long and weekly.

check.title: Two minutes. No account.

concerns.s_sounds_like_th: S sounds like TH (thamaka instead of samaka)
concerns.tongue_out: Tongue comes out between the teeth
concerns.teased: Others comment on or tease their speech
concerns.unsure: I'm not sure, I just want to check

check.therapyLabel: Has your child seen a speech therapist before?

privacy.title: Children's voices deserve the highest care.
privacy.intro: These principles shape every screen and every line of code in Lisan.

principles.title: Consent first
principles.body: Written parental consent and faculty ethics approval before any recording. Research use is a separate, optional consent.

principles.title: Store as little as possible
principles.body: Anonymous child IDs. No unnecessary personal data.

principles.title: Encrypted and deletable
principles.body: Recordings are encrypted at rest and parents can delete them at any time from settings.

principles.title: Never a diagnosis
principles.body: Every report says “screening result — confirm with a speech therapist”.

principles.title: Safety escalations
principles.body: Severe and lateral lisps always trigger a “see a therapist” recommendation.

principles.title: A bounded AI guide
principles.body: The AI agent only talks about speech practice and speaks to children through therapist-approved scripts.

privacy.contact: Questions about your data? Contact the team.
